description: React component for a submenu item in a menu, supporting nested submenus, keyboard navigation, and mobile modal handling.

classes.name: SubMenuItem
classes.description: React component representing a submenu item with support for nested menus, keyboard navigation, and mobile modal interactions.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Sets the component state to show the submenu.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Sets the component state to hide the submenu.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, opening submenus on mobile or executing actions.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for navigation and interaction.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the submenu item, including nested submenus and icons.
